name: CROSS_VERSION_RESOLUTION_CONTRACT_V12
principle: Explicit multi-version requests are VERSION_SET_RESOLVED, not ambiguity.
rules: temporal_mode CROSS_VERSION when >=2 explicit years/versions are requested
semantic document scoping may use evidence/title tokens; empty overlap falls back to Top-15 docs
version candidates must not be wiped solely because document_id tokens miss question tokens
VERSION_SET_RESOLVED requires the full requested version set on at least one document when document_scope is auto-bound
explicit document_scope may assign different versions per document
different values across requested versions are expected and are not version_conflict
router must not emit unresolved_version when status is VERSION_SET_RESOLVED
